definitions.payloadBps: decoded bytes of every WebSocket message the client received, per second
definitions.deflatedBps: the same through permessage-deflate (level 4, 8 KB window, frames under 96 B left alone), as SocketTransport
definitions.wsMsgsPerSec: WebSocket messages per second (what pays headers)
definitions.wireDeflatedBps: deflated + 66 x WS messages/s (closest to what a player pays)
definitions.busyModel: per player(N) = alone floor + own fight extra + (N-1) x per-neighbour + headers at the fighting shooter's message rate; per neighbour = (A_idle - C_idle) + (B_fight - B_idle), deflated payloads
